items.title: The chart bitcoin traders should be paying attention to
items.summary: A market at an inflection point could shape inflation trends and the prices of risk assets, from bitcoin to tech stocks.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs add $137M, pushing October back into the green
items.summary: Bitcoin ETFs drew $424 million over three days, lifting October net inflows to $111 million despite a hawkish Federal Reserve decision and weaker crypto sentiment.

items.title: Bitcoin Core Fixes 3 Security Bugs Discovered by AI
items.summary: Bitcoin Core developers have released security updates after an AI-powered code scan uncovered three vulnerabilities, including one that could allow attackers to crash Bitcoin nodes running on Windows and macOS. The findings were made public on October 28, after developers verified the issues and distributed fixes across…

items.title: AI found a way to crash bitcoin nodes on Windows and Macs. It's now public
items.summary: Three flaws a language-model scan dug up are the first disclosed under Core's new rules for bugs that are easy to find.

items.title: Bitcoin dips below $80,000 as Samsung-led tech jitters and a hawkish Fed weigh on crypto
items.summary: Bitcoin fell below $80,000 as Samsung-driven tech weakness and a hawkish Fed hold triggered a broad risk-off move. Crypto futures saw $356 million in liquidations.

items.title: Fed's hawkish rate hold keeps pressure on Bitcoin: Analysts
items.summary: Traders are pricing in a 78% chance of a December rate hike, while analysts say Treasury yields, the US dollar and upcoming inflation data could determine Bitcoin's next move.

items.title: Bitcoin Treasury Datavault AI Says It Can't Access Its BTC, Stock Tanks
items.summary: Datavault AI says it has been unable to withdraw its Bitcoin from Biconomy since June and will restate four financial reports tied to a $150 million Scilex deal.

items.title: Bitcoin-backed mortgages are coming to Canada, but borrowers are still unaware of the cost
items.summary: Prospective borrowers face collateral liquidation risks if bitcoin prices drop, though APX said property and crypto collateral will be handled distinctly.

items.title: Bitcoin Price Trades Above $81,500 as Fed Keeps Rates Steady in Split Vote
items.summary: Bitcoin price held near $81,000 after the Federal Reserve kept rates at 3.75% to 4% in a 10-2 vote. This post Bitcoin Price Trades Above $81,500 as Fed Keeps Rates Steady in Split Vote first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

items.title: Jason Calacanis' Bleak Bitcoin Prediction Draws $3M in Rival Bets–but He Won't Bite
items.summary: Three bitcoin investors have thrown down $1 million challenges to Jason Calacanis after he declared the cryptocurrency would never reclaim its record high.
